item.title: Commentary: No Wonder Your Wife Hates Football
item.description: Now that Notre Dame has gotten the snub it deserves for NOT wanting their football program to be part of the Atlantic Coast Conference (but 24 OTHER sports are ok) all the other teams are just fine with Miami getting picked for the playoffs

item.title: Huk Hosting First-Ever Sample Sale Dec. 13 on Daniel Island
item.description: Huk will host its first-ever sample sale on Saturday, Dec. 13, offering up to 70% off performance apparel and gear for men, women and kids. The event will include sample outerwear, fleece, performance shirts, bottoms and more.

item.title: Fuel Charleston to Close After 15 Years; Final Day Is Dec. 20
item.description: After more than 15 years in business, Fuel Charleston announced on social media that it will close, with its final day of service set for Saturday, Dec. 20.

item.title: A Father’s Place December 2025 Gradu-Up-Tion
item.description: A Father’s Place (AFP) is hosting its December 2025 Gradu-Up-Tion Celebration on Thursday, Dec.11, 6:30 p.m. at Royal Missionary Baptist Church. Reverend Dr. Marion Platt of Star Gospel Mission will be their guest speaker.

item.title: Judge Extends Eligibility for Connor Hickman through December 18th
item.description: Connor Hickman, a 23-year-old grad student at the College of Charleston, will continue playing for the Cougars men’s basketball team. He will take the court tomorrow night against South Florida in Tampa, FL

item.title: Gov. Henry McMaster to Chair Meeting of Homeland Security Advisory Council
item.description: Governor Henry McMaster will chair a meeting of President Donald J. Trump's Homeland Security Advisory Council (HSAC) tomorrow, Wednesday, Dec. 10, at 9 a.m.

item.title: NJ Teenager To Play Round Of A Lifetime At Kiawah
item.description: The Round of a Lifetime Foundation, a 501(c)(3) organization that enriches the lives of congenital heart patients through world-class golf experiences, is thrilled to announce its 23rd recipient, Alex Sekela, will be playing The Ocean Course

item.title: Oysters on the Point Returns to Mt. Pleasant in 2026
item.description: The Charleston Harbor Resort and Marina’s popular Oysters on the Point series will return for several dates this winter. During each event, guests can enjoy buckets of steamed oysters, live music, beach games, cold beverages, and more.

item.title: Espresso Martini Festival Returns in 2026; Tickets On Sale Dec. 12
item.description: Last year’s sold-out Espresso Martini Festival will return Saturday, Feb. 7, 2026, with the first 50 tickets sold for each session available at 50% off when sales open at 10 a.m. Friday, Dec. 12, at espressomartinifestivals.com.

item.title: Quintin’s Close-Ups: Pet of the Week (Willow)
item.description: Quintin Washington of Quintin's Close-Ups recently spoke with Lynn Rosato with Hallie Hill Animal Sanctuary, who introduces us to the latest “Pet of the Week.”
